POST $dir.newAccount
payload {}
$code == 201

# An order can mix IP addresses and DNS names. IP addresses are validated with
# http-01, like DNS names.
POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "dns", "value": "example.org"}, {"type": "ip", "value": "1.1.1.1"}, {"type": "ip", "value": "2606:4700:4700::1111"}]}
$code == 201
$body.identifiers == [{"type":"dns","value":"example.org"},{"type":"ip","value":"1.1.1.1"},{"type":"ip","value":"2606:4700:4700::1111"}]
$body.authorizations[2] exists
$body.authorizations[3] !exists
capture order = $header.Location
capture finalize = $body.finalize
capture authz0 = $body.authorizations[0]
capture authz1 = $body.authorizations[1]
capture authz2 = $body.authorizations[2]

POST-as-GET $authz0
capture chall0 = $body.challenges[0].url

POST-as-GET $authz1
$body.identifier == {"type":"ip","value":"1.1.1.1"}
$body.wildcard !exists
$body.challenges[0].type == http-01
$body.challenges[1] !exists
capture chall1 = $body.challenges[0].url

POST-as-GET $authz2
$body.identifier == {"type":"ip","value":"2606:4700:4700::1111"}
$body.challenges[0].type == http-01
capture chall2 = $body.challenges[0].url

POST $chall0
payload {}
$body.status == valid

POST $chall1
payload {}
$body.status == valid

POST $chall2
payload {}
$body.status == valid

# The CSR must request the IP addresses too.
csr dnsCSR certKey example.org

POST $finalize
payload {"csr": "$dnsCSR"}
error == badCSR

csr otherCSR certKey example.org 1.1.1.1 2606:4700:4700::1001

POST $finalize
payload {"csr": "$otherCSR"}
error == badCSR

csr goodCSR certKey 2606:4700:4700::1111 example.org 1.1.1.1

POST $finalize
payload {"csr": "$goodCSR"}
$body.status == valid
$body.certificate exists

# An order can be for IP addresses only.
POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "ip", "value": "1.1.1.1"}]}
$code == 201
capture finalize = $body.finalize
capture authz = $body.authorizations[0]

POST-as-GET $authz
capture chall = $body.challenges[0].url

POST $chall
payload {}
$body.status == valid

csr ipCSR certKey 1.1.1.1

POST $finalize
payload {"csr": "$ipCSR"}
$body.status == valid

# The same address can't be requested twice.
POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "ip", "value": "1.1.1.1"}, {"type": "ip", "value": "1.1.1.1"}]}
error == malformed

# Addresses are in dotted decimal or RFC 5952 form, without a zone, and IPv4
# addresses are not mapped to IPv6.
POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "ip", "value": ""}]}
error == rejectedIdentifier
$body.detail contains not valid

POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "ip", "value": "example.org"}]}
error == rejectedIdentifier
$body.detail contains not valid

POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "ip", "value": "1.1.1"}]}
error == rejectedIdentifier
$body.detail contains not valid

POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "ip", "value": "1.1.1.01"}]}
error == rejectedIdentifier
$body.detail contains not valid

POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "ip", "value": "1.1.1.1/32"}]}
error == rejectedIdentifier
$body.detail contains not valid

POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "ip", "value": "0x1.1.1.1"}]}
error == rejectedIdentifier
$body.detail contains not valid

POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "ip", "value": "16843009"}]}
error == rejectedIdentifier
$body.detail contains not valid

POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "ip", "value": "[2606:4700:4700::1111]"}]}
error == rejectedIdentifier
$body.detail contains not valid

POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "ip", "value": "2606:4700:4700::1111%eth0"}]}
error == rejectedIdentifier
$body.detail contains zone

POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "ip", "value": "2606:4700:4700:0:0:0:0:1111"}]}
error == rejectedIdentifier
$body.detail contains canonical form 2606:4700:4700::1111

POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "ip", "value": "2606:4700:4700::00:1111"}]}
error == rejectedIdentifier
$body.detail contains canonical form 2606:4700:4700::1111

POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "ip", "value": "2606:4700:4700::ABCD"}]}
error == rejectedIdentifier
$body.detail contains canonical form 2606:4700:4700::abcd

POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "ip", "value": "::ffff:1.1.1.1"}]}
error == rejectedIdentifier
$body.detail contains IPv4-mapped

POST $dir.newOrder
payload {"identifiers": [{"type": "ip", "value": "::ffff:101:101"}]}
error == rejectedIdentifier
$body.detail contains IPv4-mapped
